control: Кодировать Jinling как antecedent и инфраструктурный prehistory внутри T3-45, не менять master interval без ручного решения.
needed_sources: Jinling catalogues, blocks, Yang correspondence, institutional histories. [P01; P02; D06; S01]
risk: Jinling Scriptural Press начинается в 1866, тогда как master formation начинается в 1890.

control: Хранить actor categories и analytical categories раздельно; связывать каждое определение с конкретным текстом.
needed_sources: Ouyang 1922, Taixu polemics, university curricula, modern scholarship. [P08; S03; S22]
risk: Модерные акторы сами спорили, является ли Buddhism religion, philosophy, science или neixue; внешняя taxonomy может стереть stakes.

control: Моделировать reconstruction, invention, print redistribution, new education and state intervention как разные процессы.
needed_sources: Monastery reconstruction records, print histories, local archives. [S01; S02; S23]
risk: Слово «возрождение» создаёт иллюзию простого возвращения после упадка.

control: Добавить distributed authorship and labour nodes; не выводить institution из одной biography.
needed_sources: Colophons, donor lists, journal mastheads, school rosters, correspondence. [P04; P05; S12; S24]
risk: Taixu, Yang или Yinshun могут заслонить редакторов, учениц, наборщиков, donors, lecturers and local teachers.

control: Кодировать двусторонние journeys, translation choices, reprints and counter-readings.
needed_sources: Nanjō–Yang materials, Taishō editorial history, Chinese study-abroad records. [P02; P14; S18; S19]
risk: Modern terminology, editions and academic models часто проходят через Японию; схема может стать либо националистическим отрицанием, либо односторонней diffusion story.

control: Всегда хранить Taishō number вместе с work identity, base witness, variant apparatus and edition date.
needed_sources: Kan’dō Mokuroku, Taishō witness DB, SAT terms, CBC@. [P14; D02; D07; D08]
risk: Нумерация и digital availability создают эффект природной полноты, скрывая selected base texts and collations.

control: Развести speaker, recorder, editor, edition, date of delivery and publication.
needed_sources: Autographs, first periodical print, editorial prefaces, later complete works. [P07; P11; P12; INF]
risk: Записанные учениками лекции и посмертные собрания могут быть приняты за авторский final text.

control: Хранить branch-specific chronologies и только затем транснациональные reunion edges.
needed_sources: Academy records, Taiwan institutional archives, publication and migration histories. [P16; P18; D09; S07]
risk: PRC, Taiwan, Hong Kong and diaspora развиваются в разных правовых и академических режимах; затем ретроспективно соединяются.

control: Кодировать institution/governance layer отдельно от doctrinal argument and reception.
needed_sources: Regulations, curricula, textbooks, peer scholarship and independent editions. [P18; D09; INF]
risk: Official categories, patriotic education and heritage discourse влияют на curricula and publication, но не исчерпывают интеллектуальное поле.

control: Создать role-level authorship: editor, proofreader, translator, teacher, administrator, donor.
needed_sources: Editorial rosters, academy records, oral histories, women’s Buddhist periodicals. [P17; S24]
risk: Bhikṣuṇī labour in teaching, editorial work and canon/dictionary projects легко исчезает за male master narratives.

control: Сохранять raw image link, transcription release, normalization profile, correction record and editor attribution.
needed_sources: CBETA revision history, SAT character data, IIIF witness images, source code. [D01; D02; D07]
risk: Unicode, punctuation, segmentation and corrected readings могут выглядеть как свойства древнего текста.

control: Добавить rights metadata, access date, licence scope and missing-corpus register.
needed_sources: CBETA copyright, SAT terms, repository policies, local library catalogues. [D01; D02; D03; D04]
risk: Открытый просмотр не равен свободному переиспользованию; хорошо индексированные corpora вытесняют менее заметные local collections.

control: Кодировать school label как actor/time-specific classification and teaching network.
needed_sources: Course lists, reading programmes, teacher lineages, periodical debates. [S04; S09; INF]
risk: Huayan, Tiantai, Chan и Yogācāra могут быть представлены как неизменные organizations вместо shifting curricula and textual selections.

control: Хранить place/time/institution attributes; language alone не определяет цивилизационно-литературный комплекс.
needed_sources: Local catalogues, institutional histories and transnational biographies. [S02; S25]
risk: Материк, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore and diaspora обладают разными script, legal and institutional conditions.

contribution: Материальную основу позднецинской реституции текстов: отбор, collation, резьбу, печать и circulation; официальный ресурс фиксирует основание в 1866 и крупный фонд досок.
reliability: Высокая для институции и техники; конкретный текст требует отдельного bibliographic witness.
source_access: Официальный реестр нематериального наследия КНР; каталоги и onsite holdings Jinling.
source_label: [P01] 金陵刻經處 / Jinling Scriptural Press и сохранившиеся woodblocks

contribution: Стратегию возвращения утраченных текстов, связи с Nanjō Bun’yū, издательскую селекцию и формирование lay Buddhist scholarship.
reliability: Высокая, но dispersed; различать autograph, later collection и institutional attribution.
source_access: National Central Library e-book witness; Jinling catalogues; collected writings and correspondence.
source_label: [P02] 楊文會 / Yang Wenhui: каталоги, предисловия, переписка и издания

contribution: Первый крупный модерный китайский canon project после раннемодерных имперских изданий; показывает зависимость от японского печатного образца и новую machine-print economy.
reliability: Высокая для существования/состава; указанный каталог прямо отмечает, что экземпляр не оцифрован.
source_access: Fu Ssu Nien Library catalogue; physical sets and reprints; библиографии modern Tripiṭaka.
source_label: [P03] 頻伽精舍校刊大藏經 / Pinjia Canon

contribution: Раннюю серийную полемику, новости организаций, переводы и дискуссии о реформе до консолидации Taixu network.
reliability: Высокая при работе по выпуску/странице; database record не заменяет scan witness.
source_access: DILA Republican-Era Buddhist Journals catalogue; MFQ facsimile collections and library holdings.
source_label: [P04] 佛教叢報 / Fojiao congbao (Buddhist Miscellany), 1912–1914

contribution: Главный serial witness reform Buddhism: лекции, science debates, social programmes, school news and transregional exchange.
reliability: Очень высокая, но serial title имеет смены редакции, места и политического режима.
source_access: DILA catalogue; Republican periodical facsimiles; later Taiwan runs in library collections.
source_label: [P05] 海潮音 / Haichao yin, с 1920

contribution: Конкретную аргументацию о новой institutional form saṅgha, education, public role and modern state.
reliability: Высокая для текста; редакционный слой CBETA/Complete Works должен быть указан.
source_access: CBETA Online, Taixu corpus; сверять с first publication and collected-work metadata.
source_label: [P06] 太虛, 整理僧伽制度論 / Taixu, “Reorganizing the Saṅgha System”

contribution: 1,448 texts / около 7 млн знаков по описанию CBETA; объединяет doctrinal, institutional, political and autobiographical writing.
reliability: Высокая, но это редакторская конструкция 1947–1948 и далее, а не author-prepared final edition.
source_access: CBETA Online; printed editions from Shanghai/Hong Kong; compilation account.
source_label: [P07] 太虛大師全書 / Complete Works of Master Taixu

contribution: Actor-category “neixue” и знаменитое отрицание простой классификации Buddhism как religion or philosophy.
reliability: Высокая для позиции Ouyang; перевод и editorial context должны быть маркированы.
source_access: Heidelberg open sourcebook with translation/context; Chinese collected editions.
source_label: [P08] 歐陽竟無, “佛法非宗教非哲學，而為今時所必需” (1922)

contribution: Новый neixue curriculum: Yogācāra, Buddhist logic, philology, source comparison and specialist teaching.
reliability: Средне-высокая: institutional records dispersed; chronology and student rosters need archival audit.
source_access: Published lectures, institute catalogues, Ouyang/Lü corpora; academic sourcebook.
source_label: [P09] 支那內學院 / China Inner Studies Institute: curricula, lectures, publications

contribution: Переход к critical historical narrative Buddhism within modern Chinese humanities and philosophy curricula.
reliability: Высокая; edition/reprint history must be specified.
source_access: NTU DLBS bibliographic search; major Chinese university libraries and reprints.
source_label: [P10] 湯用彤, 漢魏兩晉南北朝佛教史 (1938)

contribution: Реконструкцию развития индийского буддизма и основание Yinshun’s critical vision of Chinese Buddhist renewal.
reliability: Высокая; distinguish author edition, later revisions and digital release.
source_access: CBETA Online; Yinshun corpus and print editions.
source_label: [P11] 印順, 印度之佛教 / Yinshun, Buddhism in India

contribution: Dependent origination, ethics, community and human-centred articulation of the Dharma in modern prose.
reliability: Высокая; contemporary copyright restrictions apply through CBETA category B.
source_access: CBETA Online with export functions; print corpus.
source_label: [P12] 印順, 佛法概論 / Yinshun, Overview of the Buddha-Dharma

contribution: Modern curricular condensation of the Buddhist path, linking doctrine, practice and lay/monastic education.
reliability: Высокая; later translations are separate expression nodes.
source_access: CBETA Online; authorized print editions and translations.
source_label: [P13] 印順, 成佛之道 / Yinshun, The Way to Buddhahood

contribution: Modern numbering, collation apparatus and international citation standard for Chinese Buddhist texts.
reliability: Очень высокая as edition; not identical with abstract work or best witness.
source_access: SAT text/image database; CBETA derivatives; physical sets; Taishō witness database.
source_label: [P14] 大正新脩大藏經 / Taishō Shinshū Daizōkyō

contribution: Амбицию заново организовать Chinese Buddhist canon; длительный interrupted compilation and later completion.
reliability: Средне-высокая: access uneven; project chronology and “completion” require edition-specific description.
source_access: Physical set; recent academic reconstruction and library catalogues.
source_label: [P15] 普慧大藏經 / Puhui Canon project, 1940s–1998

contribution: PRC canon-building, integration of historic witnesses and a new national scholarly edition.
reliability: Высокая for edition metadata; image/full-text access varies by volume and rights.
source_access: BDRC/BUDA record; printed set; CBETA catalogue material.
source_label: [P16] 中華大藏經（漢文部分） / Zhonghua Dazangjing, 1984–1996

contribution: Collective bhikṣuṇī-led and scholar-assisted editing, vernacular explanation, punctuation, indexing and Humanistic Buddhism public pedagogy.
reliability: Высокая for project history; site explicitly limits scraping and reuse—record rights per object.
source_access: Fo Guang official history; online dictionary and printed canon series.
source_label: [P17] 佛光大藏經 и 佛光大辭典 / Fo Guang canon and dictionary projects

contribution: Monastic higher education, undergraduate/graduate programmes, research outputs and contemporary curricular classification.
reliability: Высокая for current institution; historical phases need archival sources beyond official commemoration.
source_access: Official site, admissions, curricula, publications, library and regulations.
source_label: [P18] 中國佛學院 / Buddhist Academy of China: curricula and publications

contribution: Comparative Indian/Chinese Buddhist history, source criticism, Yogācāra and Buddhist logic in modern scholarly Chinese.
reliability: Высокая; CBETA identifies this corpus as separately copyrighted material.
source_access: CBETA Online LC series; print collected works.
source_label: [P19] 呂澂佛學著作集 / Lü Cheng Buddhist Studies corpus

contribution: Searchable canonical and modern corpora, exports, correction history, catalogues, character tools and version information; founded 15 Feb 1998, foundation completed 7 Aug 2023.
reliability: Очень высокая; licences differ by collection and require release-level recording.
source_access: Online reader, downloads/open data, history and copyright pages.
source_label: [D01] CBETA Foundation / CBETA Online

contribution: Taishō text, images, search, rare-character work and research-linked access; committee established 17 March 1998.
reliability: Очень высокая; cite database version and respect publisher-approved use conditions.
source_access: University of Tokyo SAT portal and terms of use.
source_label: [D02] SAT Daizōkyō Text Database

contribution: Work–version–person–place linked data, IIIF, large-scale Buddhist manuscript/print preservation and cross-repository graph potential.
reliability: Очень высокая; Chinese coverage is selective relative to Tibetan and partner corpora.
source_access: BUDA portal, BDRC records and APIs/LOD documentation.
source_label: [D03] BDRC / BUDA Buddhist Digital Archives

contribution: Secondary literature, full-text articles, authority files and institutional history from 1995; crucial for modern scholarship discovery.
reliability: Очень высокая; bibliographic visibility is uneven by language and journal permissions.
source_access: NTU DLBS search, full-text and author authority services.
source_label: [D04] NTU Digital Library of Buddhist Studies

contribution: 152 journal titles and more than 140,000 articles, including scholarship, images, news and publication notices.
reliability: Высокая as index; consult facsimile page for quotation and layout.
source_access: Dharma Drum Institute of Liberal Arts digital archives.
source_label: [D05] Catalog Database of Republican Era Buddhist Journals

contribution: Official holdings and technique context for Jinling; links historical texts to surviving blocks, impressions and preservation labour.
reliability: Высокая for institutional facts; item-level catalogues remain distributed.
source_access: China Intangible Cultural Heritage portal; NCL and specialist libraries.
source_label: [D06] National heritage and library witnesses for Jinling editions

contribution: Visualizes base/collation texts, holdings, images and links beyond the normalized Taishō text; fourth major update released Feb 2026.
reliability: Очень высокая; coverage focuses on Chinese portion, especially vols. 1–55, and is expanding.
source_access: Toyo Bunko / JSPS project; IIIF-linked witnesses.
source_label: [D07] Taishō Base and Collation Texts Database

contribution: Scholarly claims about authors, translators, dates and textual relations; supports assertion-level provenance rather than fixed inherited labels.
reliability: Высокая; attribution entries are hypotheses with sources, not immutable metadata.
source_access: CBC@ project; links from Taishō witness database.
source_label: [D08] Chinese Buddhist Canonical Attributions (CBC@)

contribution: 2026 admissions, degrees, teaching principles, research and library information; confirms continuity of a living monastic academic field.
reliability: Высокая for current state; self-presentation requires triangulation for contested history.
source_access: Official academy website.
source_label: [D09] Buddhist Academy of China official digital platform

contribution: Vernacular Chinese Buddhist lexicography, modern figures/events and editorial history; project begun 1978, first publication 1988.
reliability: Высокая; all-rights-reserved and explicit no-scraping request must be encoded.
source_access: Official FGDB portal and English beta.
source_label: [D10] Fo Guang Dictionary of Buddhism online

contribution: Dates, publication sequence, institutional movements and links to authorized electronic texts.
reliability: Высокая, with normal caution toward commemorative framing.
source_access: Yinshun Foundation and CBETA Y-series.
source_label: [D11] Yinshun chronology and authorized digital corpus

contribution: Монастырская реконструкция, печать, fundraising, property and institutions от late Qing до ранней PRC.
limitations: Не является полной intellectual history; doctrinal schools covered selectively.
source_label: [S01] Gregory Adam Scott, Building the Buddhist Revival (2020)

contribution: Возвращает Buddhism в историю urban modernity, diplomacy, war, state and society; даёт множественные regional scenes.
limitations: Сборник не создаёт единой chronology; главы имеют разные масштабы.
source_label: [S02] Jan Kiely & J. Brooks Jessup (eds.), Recovering Buddhism in Modern China (2016)

contribution: Республиканские дебаты о science, epistemology and Buddhism; широко использует periodical corpus.
limitations: Фокус на 1890-е–1940-е и science discourse; не покрывает позднюю digital phase.
source_label: [S03] Erik J. Hammerstrom, The Science of Chinese Buddhism (2015)

contribution: Huayan как modern teaching network, academies, publications and practice rather than timeless school.
limitations: Huayan-focused; requires parallel studies for Tiantai, Chan, Pure Land and Yogācāra.
source_label: [S04] Erik J. Hammerstrom, The Huayan University Network (2020)

contribution: Taixu’s institutional, social and doctrinal reform project and its broad network.
limitations: Taixu-centred; later scholarship complicates a singular reformer narrative.
source_label: [S05] Don A. Pittman, Toward a Modern Chinese Buddhism: Taixu’s Reforms (2001)

contribution: Большой empirical survey of Chinese Buddhist institutions and revival before 1949.
limitations: Период и analytical vocabulary отражают mid-century scholarship; требует historiographic critique.
source_label: [S06] Holmes Welch, The Buddhist Revival in China (1968)

contribution: Institutional transformations, policies and disruptions in the PRC through the Cultural Revolution era.
limitations: Cold War and source constraints; not a final account of post-1949 intellectual life.
source_label: [S07] Holmes Welch, Buddhism under Mao (1972)

contribution: Media, sound, print and material practices; полезна против purely doctrinal narrative.
limitations: Не охватывает все академические и canonical projects.
source_label: [S08] Francesca Tarocco, The Cultural Practices of Modern Chinese Buddhism (2007)

contribution: Modern Yogācāra/Faxiang, mind, science, New Confucian interfaces and figures around Ouyang/Lü.
limitations: School/concept-focused; print and institutional infrastructure secondary.
source_label: [S09] John Makeham (ed.), Transforming Consciousness: Yogācāra Thought in Modern China (2014)

contribution: Ouyang Jingwu, Chinese Buddhist scholasticism and redefinition of authentic Buddhist knowledge.
limitations: Один institutional/intellectual cluster; not general history of modern Buddhism.
source_label: [S10] Eyal Aviv, Differentiating the Pearl from the Fish-Eye (2020)

contribution: Argumentative neixue, Buddhist logic and modern scholastic identity around Ouyang/Lü.
limitations: Требует чтения вместе с primary Chinese materials and later monograph.
source_label: [S11] Eyal Aviv, “A Well-Reasoned Dharma” (2015)

contribution: Religious publishing, beginner books, subscriptions, editorial labour and print networks.
limitations: Corpus dispersed across articles; local case studies should not be universalized.
source_label: [S12] Gregory Adam Scott, studies of Buddhist publishing and readers

contribution: Как books and reading practices create modern Buddhist subjects and publics.
limitations: Case-specific and media-centred; doctrinal genealogy limited.
source_label: [S13] Gregory Adam Scott, “Conversion by the Book”

contribution: Wuchang Buddhist Academy as model of modern Buddhist education and reform.
limitations: Одна institution; needs cross-check with other academies and archival records.
source_label: [S14] Suat Yan Lai, “The Wuchang Ideal” (2017)

contribution: Long transformation of Chinese Buddhist education, academy system and modern curriculum.
limitations: Macro model may smooth regional and political discontinuities.
source_label: [S15] Liu, “From Sangha Forest to Buddhist Academy” (2023)

contribution: Yinshun’s historical method, periodization and normative reconstruction of Buddhism.
limitations: Yinshun-focused; verify exact argument against Chinese primary editions.
source_label: [S16] Marcus Bingenheimer, study of Yinshun’s Buddhist historiography (2009)

contribution: Material history of Buddhist canon, printing and circulation across East Asia—essential background for modern canon projects.
limitations: Большая часть посвящена до-modern period; T3-45 uses it as transmission prehistory.
source_label: [S17] Jiang Wu & Lucille Chia (eds.), Spreading Buddha’s Word in East Asia (2016)

contribution: Modern East Asian canon projects, standardization and national/transnational editorial politics.
limitations: Coverage distributed by project; requires item-level follow-up for Pinjia/Taishō/Puhui.
source_label: [S18] Jiang Wu & Greg Wilkinson (eds.), Reinventing the Tripitaka (2017)

contribution: Machine printing, Japanese model, patronage and modern canon construction in Shanghai.
limitations: Narrow canon case; exact edition and chapter should be frozen in the bibliographic database.
source_label: [S19] Gregory Adam Scott, work on the 1913 Pinjia Canon

contribution: Самая актуальная реконструкция Puhui project, interruption and publication history.
limitations: Одна article-level reconstruction; physical volumes and archival documents still require audit.
source_label: [S20] Tao Shen, “The Compilation and Publication of the Puhui Canon” (2025)

contribution: Markup, text encoding, rare characters and the epistemic consequences of digitizing Buddhist texts.
limitations: Early digital phase; current CBETA/SAT architectures have expanded substantially.
source_label: [S21] Christian Wittern, “Digital Text and Digital Resources” / Chinese Buddhist e-text studies

contribution: История imported category “philosophy”, Chinese conceptual translation and Buddhist positioning.
limitations: Conceptual frame must be combined with institutional/print evidence.
source_label: [S22] Thierry Meynard, “Introducing Buddhism as Philosophy” and related studies

contribution: Temple destruction, modern state categories, education and the contested political environment of religious reform.
limitations: Macro thesis and date-marker are debated; not Buddhist-specific in all details.
source_label: [S23] Vincent Goossaert, “1898: The Beginning of the End for Chinese Religion?” (2006)

contribution: Bhikṣuṇī education, female institutional agency and correction of male-master narratives.
limitations: Focused case; broader network still underdocumented.
source_label: [S24] Daniela Campo, research on women’s Buddhist academies and modern education (2022)

contribution: Southeast Asian Chinese Buddhist networks, mobility and institutional circulation—important outgoing/transnational context.
limitations: Geography extends beyond China; not a direct survey of T3-45 core.
source_label: [S25] Jack Meng-Tat Chia, Monks in Motion (2020)

contribution: Maitreya, Pure Land, anarchism and the political imagination of Republican Buddhism.
limitations: One doctrinal-political movement; not equivalent to whole reform field.
source_label: [S26] Justin Ritzinger, Anarchy in the Pure Land (2017)

contribution: State–saṅgha relations, reform categories and modern institutional negotiations.
limitations: Synthesis; local archives and actors may complicate periodization.
source_label: [S27] Stefania Travagnin, “Buddhism and Modernity in China” / Sangha-state reform studies

contribution: Latest witness-level correction to treating Taishō as a transparent text; links scholarship, holdings and images.
limitations: Project scope is still expanding and not all works have equal witness coverage.
source_label: [S28] Taishō Base and Collation Texts Database research outputs, 2018–2026

contribution: Institutional history, OCR/input, gaiji, versions, foundation transition and correction infrastructure.
limitations: Self-documentation; supplement with independent technical studies for evaluation.
source_label: [S29] CBETA documentation and revision-history research, updated 2026

contribution: Current scale, authority files, full-text services and institutional phases from 1995 onward.
limitations: Database coverage depends on permissions, indexing and volunteer labour.
source_label: [S30] NTU DLBS current bibliographic/authority documentation, updated through 2026
